member.name: M:HumanGateway.Relay.Api.RequestValidation.GatewayIdRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,127}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match an ASCII letter or digit.
○ Match a character in the set [\-.0-:A-Z_a-z] atomically at least 7 and at most 127 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:HumanGateway.Relay.Api.RequestValidation.RegistrationTokenRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^hgrt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,251}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match the string "hgrt_".
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least 43 and at most 251 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:HumanGateway.Relay.Api.RequestValidation.ParticipantAddressRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(human|agent|system):[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]{1,191}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 3 alternative expressions.
○ Match the string "human".
○ Match the string "agent".
○ Match the string "system".
○ Match ':'.
○ Match a character in the set [+\-.0-9@-Z_a-z] atomically at least 1 and at most 191 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: T:HumanGateway.Relay.Security.RegistrationTokens
member.summary: Registration-token primitives for gateway identity (AUTH-FR-01, SP-02, SP-07). member.name: T:HumanGateway.Relay.Services.GatewayService
member.summary: Gateway registration lifecycle (RELAY-FR-03, AUTH-FR-01, SP-02, SP-07): request a registration token, confirm registration by presenting it, and rotate the token before it expires. The Relay persists only the SHA-256 token fingerprint — the plaintext token is returned to the caller exactly once (SP-07) and is never logged. Only REGISTERED gateways are accepted as rendezvous/sync targets; SUSPENDED and REVOKED identities are rejected on every operation (SP-02).

member.name: M:HumanGateway.Relay.Services.GatewayService.RequestRegistrationAsync(HumanGateway.Relay.Api.RegisterGatewayRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Step 1 of the registration handshake: creates the gateway identity in PENDING and issues a fresh registration token (returned once). Idempotency note: an existing PENDING/UNREGISTERED identity is a 409 — the previously issued token is unrecoverable (only its fingerprint is stored), so a re-request must not silently invalidate it (SP-07). Use the issued token, or rotate once registered.

member.summary: Step 2 of the registration handshake: presents the issued token and moves the identity to REGISTERED. Rejects unregistered, suspended, and revoked identities (SP-02) and any token mismatch or expiry (REGISTRATION_TOKEN_INVALID / REGISTRATION_TOKEN_EXPIRED).

member.summary: Rotates the registration token of a REGISTERED gateway: verifies the current token, issues a fresh one, and persists only its fingerprint.
